mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM product_review WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND sku_id = #{skuId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_review (order_id, product_id, sku_id, user_id, username, rating, content, images_json, videos_json, created_at) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{productId}, #{skuId}, #{userId}, #{username}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{imagesJson}, #{videosJson}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.order_id, r.product_id, r.sku_id, s.sku_code, r.user_id, r.username, r.rating, r.content, r.images_json, r.videos_json, r.created_at FROM product_review r LEFT JOIN product_sku s ON s.id = r.sku_id WHERE r.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
SELECT AVG(rating) FROM product_review WHERE product_id = #{productId}
